activity_baseline.features: historically visible activity counts at each query time

assumptions: Hosted snapshot with record-time filtering; historical relationship changes, deletions and merges remain unresolved.
No raw mutable/text attribute or task target is a node feature; richer historical feature availability remains unresolved.
Constant encoder statistics are independent of validation; learned preprocessing and baseline fitting use training only.
The fixed 8192-query validation subset is not the final full-validation metric.
One selected training-query pass measures this bounded schedule; convergence and predictive superiority require evidence.
Post-training execution parity covers one sampled validation batch and does not measure trained inference speed.
notes: Start a fresh model for 2000 total reference-training updates on 64000 selected training queries. Keep the resulting checkpoint for later paired inference measurements; do not claim a final predictor or trained inference acceleration from this run.
